title: LandlordGuard Late Fee Basis by Installment Size
content:
**Size bands.** On the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy, how the late-fee basis is set depends on the amount of the late installment, which is the most recently billed installment: an installment above 1000 USD takes 1.2 percent of the installment amount; an installment of 250 USD or less takes half the tier's late fee; any other installment takes the tier's late fee.

The late-fee basis is the starting amount of the late fee, to which the late-fee adjustment is added.

| Amount of the most recently billed installment | Late-fee basis |
|---|---|
| above 1000 USD | 1.2 percent of the installment amount |
| above 250 USD and up to 1000 USD | the tier's late fee |
| 250 USD or less | half the tier's late fee |

## Tier late fee and its half (USD)

| Tier | Late fee | Half |
|---|---|---|
| DP-1 Basic | 10.00 | 5.00 |
| DP-2 Broad | 10.00 | 5.00 |
| DP-3 Special | 10.00 | 5.00 |
| DP-3 Special Plus | 10.00 | 5.00 |
| DP-3 Premier | 5.00 | 2.50 |
| DP-3 Portfolio | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Both sides of each band (hypothetical installments on a tier with a 10.00 USD late fee)

| Installment amount | Late-fee basis |
|---|---|
| 1,250.00 | 1.2 percent of 1,250.00, that is 15.00 |
| 1,000.00 | 10.00 |
| 1,000.01 | 1.2 percent of 1,000.01, that is 12.00012, rounded only in the final fee |
| 250.01 | 10.00 |
| 250.00 | 5.00 |
